description: A room or place a gathering programmes sessions into. Written by the gathering actor. A venue is a place, not a person, so it publishes cleanly; for a private residence the address follows the calendar event's tiered disclosure (neighbourhood on the record, exact address app-side).

features.description: Feature tags (projector, whiteboard, microphone) matched against schellingpoint.draft.proposal#requiredFeatures.

style.description: Room style, e.g. theater, classroom, lounge.

locations.description: Where the venue is, in the same union community.lexicon.calendar.event uses.
